contract.estimator_scope: per-channel sampled visible-sky/unoccluded-sky ratio times existing SH plus unchanged weighted hit/N; finite-sample ratio bias and SH approximation, Ng-clipped samples remain denominator-only; zero channel denominator uses same-weight miss fraction
contract.reconstruction_implementation: bounded unique tile indices + one accepted-neighbor atomic per supported receiver

history.sequence: base_seed XOR uint32(successful_RGB_sequence * 0x9e3779b9); reset sequence zero
history.eligible: current K25 reconstruction has at least one actual traced low-anchor support; SH fallback age zero
history.dynamic: real per-ID primary rigid correspondence; secondary visibility is locally unobserved
history.resources: 112 B per full pixel +176B camera UBO +16+272N rigid table, plus optional48B/pixel debug buffer
history.bias: nearest reprojection and neighborhood clamp/age-capped EMA are biased; reconstructed samples overlap; age is not spp
history.reset: scene/world/epoch/phase/camera-id/lens/extent/lights/exposure/signal/presentation-source/camera-cuts/explicit; bound adjacent presentation required; per-instance motion is reprojected

contract.fallback: current-pixel unoccluded diffuse environment SH; not traced GI
contract.normal_encoding: octahedral 10+10 bits plus traced flag, exactly represented float integer
contract.rho_encoding: RGB UNORM8 as exact positive float integer; absolute channel error <= 0.5/255
contract.reconstruction: at most 25 unique tile anchors; same actual ID, valid coverage, relative depth <= .003, shading-normal dot >= .98; normalized supported weights
contract.weights: Gaussian sigma=1.5 tile widths, nearest 5x5 anchor window
contract.anchor_filter: same 25-anchor filter, including the always-supported own sample
contract.primary: full-rate direct + environment specular + optional near mirror; diffuse IBL overridden by zero
contract.guide: full-rate current shading normal and local SH fallback; only eligible tile anchors trace real incoming light
contract.timing: includes two full raster draws, true anchor rays/terminal shadows, reconstruction, all copies; no extra session

compact.history: separate GPU reprojection after immutable current compact reconstruction
compact.full_attributes: primary location4: RGBA32F SH.rgb and oct10x2 shading-normal numeric integer; rho remains primary alpha
compact.guide_attributes: own independent low-resolution forward-depth/ID/valid/Ns; never relabel full-rate attributes as low hits
compact.odd: out-of-bounds regular anchors are invalid, never clamped; full receivers use supported in-bounds neighbors or own SH
compact.footprint: K25 receiver-local ID/depth/normal gates; low hit also checked against actual full anchor attributes
compact.raster_limit: analytic sample centers match; finite hardware raster precision can differ, rejected support is reported
compact.counter_partition: reconstructed + fallback + nondiffuse = full visible; traced_anchor_pixels independently counts valid low traced anchors

proposal_budget.distance: unchanged full-distance terminal queries; no local-radius approximation
proposal_budget.zero_contribution: below shading hemisphere or Ng-clipped proposals remain in the eight-trial normalization
proposal_budget.ratio: same finite-sample visibility ratio and SH approximation; black environment reduces to hit/8
proposal_budget.history: composed separately by the unchanged rigid age<=4 implementation

rigid_history.motion: same FP32 current matrices used by raster/TLAS; previous successful publication matrices; sorted uint32 ID lookup
rigid_history.clock: bound adjacent presented records with exact source SHA/index/current frame digest/previous full key,time,digest; source ticks need not advance by one
rigid_history.limitations: Primary reprojection, current direct/specular changes, and current incoming neighborhood cannot prove hidden secondary visibility unchanged; bounded biased history, not physical or independent spp.

lowres_filter.weights: separable [1,2,1] product, normalized over accepted low cells
lowres_filter.support: center and conservative intervening low-grid rectangle: traced, same actual ID/coverage and matching full anchor/depth/Ns; unsupported center original
lowres_filter.resources: one 16-byte RGBA low-grid SSBO; actual original guide MRT immutable; compute-write/read barrier before original K25
lowres_filter.history: original age4 and rejection unchanged, now consumes filtered current incoming
lowres_filter.registered_quality: three poses x two 65536-spp refs: same-ID8x8 left-arm block luminance residual RMS each improves >=10%, mean bias increase <=.005; other pixel/motion/speed gates separate; no retuning

panels.motion: fixed in emitter space, current geometry, no direct-light history
panels.progressive: within-cell shift per unchanged-state batch, reset on state change

contours.visibility: nearest opaque TLAS hit at four rotated subpixel positions within the camera clip planes
contours.scope: pixels with a different instance or background in their clipped 3x3 center neighborhood
contours.shading: per-surface center radiance; a different hit needs a local ID match and forward depth within 3 percent
contours.unsupported: retain the original center for the entire pixel when a hit has no supported donor
contours.resolve: four equal scene-linear HDR weights before exposure and the single display transform
contours.history: center-sampled history stays independent of color resolve

resident_environment_info.importance_scope: native configuration flags: named progressive cubemap-CDF shader compatibility (SpecId72), and successfully uploaded nonconstant positive-mass map; not a ray, sample, visibility or capture counter; legacy reserved zeros remain valid
resident_environment_info.importance_mass_scope: private upload alpha: footprint-filtered max RGB times exact cube-texel solid angle; L0 inclusive FP32 cubemap CDF, L1 strict inverse-directory indices; adjacent stored CDF differences define the proposal; original public RGBA and every RGB mip unchanged
resident_environment_info.capture_scope: successful RGB captures with an uploaded directional environment; sky draw count is not foreground pixel count
resident_environment_info.snapshot: last live query; final GPU allocations are reported by teardown telemetry

resident_texture_info.capture_scope: successful RGB captures with bound texture instances, not visible textured pixel count
resident_texture_info.upload_scope: cumulative actual texture image and metadata GPU writes, including default white sentinel; excluded from geometry_upload_bytes
resident_texture_info.snapshot: last live query, not final allocation state; teardown verified by allocation telemetry

resident_readback.snapshot: last live query, not final mapping state; teardown verified by allocation telemetry
resident_readback.capacity_scope: logical Vulkan readback buffer capacity, not total VkDeviceMemory allocation size

resident_profile.scope: cumulative successful captures including warmup; excludes initial static geometry upload
resident_profile.gpu_scope: TLAS + full primary + compact GI + K25 current incoming + barrier + GPU reprojection/clamp/recombine + copies
resident_profile.snapshot: last live query, retained after close; final ownership is checked by telemetry

resident_telemetry.allocation_scope: this context explicit VkDeviceMemory allocations; not driver total VRAM
resident_telemetry.wait_scope: host wall time blocked in fence waits, including upload; not GPU kernel time

resident_ray_query_info.capture_scope: successful RGB-requested captures, not ray count or visible shadow pixel count
resident_ray_query_info.buffer_scope: logical AS and scratch buffer bytes; actual VkDeviceMemory allocation telemetry is separate
resident_ray_query_info.update_scope: each capture builds or updates TLAS, including two cameras at the same frame key
resident_ray_query_info.upload_scope: additional VkAccelerationStructureInstanceKHR records, 64 bytes per instance per capture; not the ordinary forward/inverse matrix buffer
resident_ray_query_info.snapshot: last live query, retained after close; final allocation teardown is reported by resident telemetry
